finding: Current official Qwen3.5-4B is a 4B causal language model with Vision Encoder. Its configuration exposes a 24-layer visual encoder with hidden size 1024, out hidden size 2560, patch size 16, spatial merge 2 and image/video token identities; the processor uses Qwen3VLProcessor semantics.
why_interesting_for_target_architecture: Frank already pays for a native deep visual encoder in the required core model, so a second heavy Retina semantic encoder should be treated as a baseline requiring positive evidence rather than a default architecture component.
falsifier: Matched Frank execution can still show a separate lightweight/heavy encoder materially improves total task/resource Pareto performance enough to justify duplication.
